title: Dynamic Factor Graphs for Attack Preemption
problem: Supercomputing systems face sophisticated attacks; noisy alerts and unreliable signals mask real attacks leading to data breaches
motivation: National-scale HPC systems at NCSA require proactive security to prevent system compromise and data loss
method: Live-traffic security testbed using factor-graph-based dynamic models for attack preemption; visualization tools for attack analysis
key_novelty: Factor-graph-based detection system deployed in petascale production HPC environment
contributions: Characterizes 228+ security incidents from NCSA archives
Develops attack visualization tool for operators
Successfully detects real ransomware family; improves production Zeek policies
limitations: Single ransomware detection; broader applicability unclear
